llm.summary: The skill's description and examples claim full A/B analysis and CLI commands, but there is no implementation, install spec, or declared runtime requirements — this mismatch is ambiguous and worth caution.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md promises data import, statistical calculations, visualization and recommendations, but the package contains no code and no install spec. The example CLI calls (openclaw run ab-test-analyzer ...) imply an executable or implementation that is not provided or declared. This mismatch means the skill as published cannot actually perform the advertised capabilities without hidden implementation elsewhere.

llm.guidance: This skill claims to do A/B statistical analysis and shows CLI examples, but the bundle contains no code or install instructions — it cannot actually run as-is. Before installing or using it: 1) ask the publisher for source code or an installable release; 2) verify where data will be processed and stored (local only vs. sent to external endpoints); 3) test with non-sensitive/sample datasets first; and 4) avoid providing any credentials until you confirm a legitimate implementation and review its code or a trusted package source. The mismatch between advertised capability and provided artifacts is the main red flag.
